edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor, making ownership caller-dependent
transferOwnership writes the caller-approved pending owner derived from the privileged msg.sender flow
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the transfer
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so caller identity controls which balance is moved
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], caller identity controls the allowance owner
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], using caller identity as the spender
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callback
Owned constructor assigns owner
transferOwnership stores _newOwner into newOwner
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0)

Lira constructor computes and stores the fixed _totalSupply
Lira constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner]
_totalSupply is produced by the unchecked multiplication expression 1000000000000000000 * 10**uint(decimals)
Result of the arithmetic expression flows into the _totalSupply state variable
totalSupply reads _totalSupply
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub for the burned-balance subtraction
balanceOf reads the balances mapping
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient
transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit balances[msg.sender]
transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit balances[to]

transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for both balance and allowance debits
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance

approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract, which can reenter the token
The receiveApproval callback can reenter approveAndCall or other token entry points before the call returns
